correctness.rationale: Coherent-state trace-norm integration gives the exact double integral and area-coordinate normalization. Two endpoint derivatives give a convolution term plus a radial potential; disk automorphism invariance pins the latter to the first harmonic. Parseval fixes the factor pi-squared. Gamma–Bessel mixture and its positive Riccati ratio prove strict ordering of all c_n, while a binomial product yields the hypergeometric expression and exact rational example. Standalone quadrature and independent coefficient computation pass 72 finite assertions; infinite claims follow from the written proof, not numerics.

originality.rationale: The focal January 9, 2024 Nicola–Riccardi paper proves global Hilbert–Schmidt hyperbolic rearrangement for Cauchy-wavelet localization but does not determine the full angular shape Hessian, the positivity/order of its Fourier curvatures, or the sharp quadrupole coefficient; these are not implied by the qualitative maximizing theorem. Ramos–Tilli and Gómez–Kalaj–Melentijević–Ramos address operator-norm concentration rather than squared Hilbert–Schmidt purity. Relevant general shape-variation results have different kernels and do not calculate these coefficients. Targeted searches found no dominating result. Historical-priority uncertainty remains.

value.rationale: Existing global hyperbolic rearrangement identifies disks but leaves local conditioning and soft deformation modes unknown. The complete Fourier curvature spectrum distinguishes two exact isometry directions from infinitely many strictly stable modes and pinpoints the universal least-stable quadrupole with an exact parameter-dependent coefficient for every disk radius and Bergman/wavelet parameter. These are natural nontrivial spectral shape data of the squared Hilbert–Schmidt localization functional, rather than an arbitrary finite computation. No new global stability theorem is claimed.
